draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Union Dynamics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Glad to hear Wrenfield is landing well so far, and that adding the rest of the team is the next step. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier for a larger group.

On the work side, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so your team will have somewhere real to land once they're in.

Want me to help you get that first project and the invites sorted this week?

Best,
Nadia
